name: status
meaning: PS1 receive-buffer byte 0: 0 = read OK, 1 = InputMgr_Poll failed. SIGNED: movsx at 0x55f01f / 0x55f06b

name: typeLen
meaning: PS1 byte 1 as a bitfield {len:4, type:4} (PadTypeLen): type = controller id (4 digital, 7 analog), read and written as a C bitfield (shr 4 / and 0xf; 0x55e535, 0x55f168)

name: rightX
meaning: right stick X, always 0x80 on PC

name: rightY
meaning: right stick Y, always 0x80 on PC
